driver: A whole population is billed on a different basis and is identifiable only by its absence from the event streams, so a faithful pipeline that collapses to the filed grain with an inner join drops it entirely, while the closed-period corpus is blind by construction because that population exists only in the open period.
driver_concrete: Billing spec 1.3 bills committed-use accounts on contracted units whether metered or not; the plan opened 1 July 2026, so 633 of 1,208 accounts billed have no meter rows and no plan flag, and the meter-only pipeline that ties all six closed cycles to the cent misses their 892,468.13 USD.
stump: A competent solver applies all four spec rules, back-tests the meter-only pipeline against six closed cycles to the cent and files 726,439.72 USD, never noticing that 633 committed-use accounts have no meter rows and vanish from the account-cycle frame.
